# VPS Comparison
> Compare VPS, cloud-compute, and managed WordPress products by real cost, management model, workload, capacity, and billing. The homepage Finder currently ranks 21 products across 5 providers, with game-server sizing and managed WordPress as first-class buyer intents.

## Why 4 GB
- This site compares 4 GB to 4 GB only.
- A VPS shares RAM among Linux, the panel or web stack, the database, and the site.
- After the OS, 1 GB is too small for a live WordPress site or a site you keep online.
- Hostinger KVM 1 is 4 GB at about $6.49/month intro (renewal about $11.99/month).
- Vultr High Performance 4 GB and DigitalOcean Basic 4 GB Droplets are about $24/month.
- Vultr/DigitalOcean ~$6 plans are 1 GB. DigitalOcean $4 is 512 MB. Do not treat those as equal to 4 GB.
- 1 GB is for a short hourly test (SSH, a tiny script, delete in days). It is not for live WordPress. This site still compares 4 GB.
- AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud are public-cloud VMs, not this core comparison path.

## Methodology
- Compare the same RAM class first so teaser 1 GB plans do not distort the decision.
- Match billing to runtime: prepaid intro pricing for always-on workloads versus hourly billing for short-lived infrastructure.
- Check region before checkout when latency or data location matters, then confirm the selected provider offers that location.
- The current database snapshot is dated 25 Aug 2026. Verified products show the real last-check date, and partial products remain labeled. Confirm the merchant cart before payment.
- Some outbound links are affiliate links. Product facts, editorial fit scores, and affiliate links are separate data layers. The Finder is rules-based; game sizing is not a benchmark and paid relationships do not define eligibility.
